mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code (group_code, code, name, description, sort_order, status, extra_data) VALUES (#{groupCode}, #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), #{extraData}::jsonb)
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_code, code, name, description, sort_order, status, extra_data::text AS extra_data, created_at, updated_at FROM code WHERE group_code = #{groupCode} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE code SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, extra_data = #{extraData}::jsonb, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM code WHERE group_code = #{groupCode} AND code = #{code})
